_comments.top_crop: [x, y, width, height] in original top-view source pixels; x/y are the top-left corner measured from the source image's left/top edges.
_comments.constraint_square: [x, y, width, height] in cropped top-view pixels before the video hflip/vflip; x/y are the square's top-left corner measured from the crop's left/top edges.
_comments.preview_time: Source-video time in seconds used for the displayed editing frame; it does not change video timing.
